title: kbmon shows a landed item as still landing at step verify, because a verify row in the same millisecond as land.end re-adds the landing
goal: A landing whose land.end row is recorded is never shown as in progress by kbmon's sprint panel, whatever land.step rows share its timestamp or follow it: on 2026-11-08 --status sprints printed 'landing A paid session-load record…, at step verify, last step 29 min ago' and 'landing Sessions no person watches…, at step verify, last step 11.2 days ago' while ops showed land.end exit=0 at 16:48:46.898Z and backlog.py runs said landed; mon_sprint's landing reader removes the landing on land.end and the trailing verify row adds it back. Relates to BG-v53lnj6a and BG-i6vjrbng (row order of land.end and land.step).

run: import subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--status','sprints','--timeout','60'],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(r.returncode!=0 or 'at step verify' in r.stdout)
